criteria.requirement: Add Queryable.export_csv(stream,columns=None,where=None,where_args=None,order_by=None,limit=None,offset=None,dialect="excel"), available on real Table/View. Validate requested column order/no duplicates against actual schema before writing, then csv.writer header and iterate rows_where lazily with quoted selected identifiers and bound where_args. Return actual data row count; empty table still header, Unicode/commas/quotes/multiline fields roundtrip through csv.reader, NULL follows CSV empty-field convention. Never close caller stream, materialize all rows, mutate DB or claim lossless SQLite type encoding. Existing CLI export remains.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
